data.title: 菲伦 · 城镇甜品店·巨型圣代与鼓鼓腮帮
data.description: 【菲伦 · 城镇甜品店·巨型圣代与满足腮帮】装潢温馨的城镇甜品屋里，菲伦坐在桌前，双手捧着比脸还大的巨型草莓冰淇淋圣代。她鼓起塞得满满的腮帮子幸福地眯起眼睛，头顶仿佛冒出了小花——「这家店的奶油甜度非常完美……芙莉莲大人要是再赖床的话，我就要把属于她的那份也全部吃掉了。」
data.promptProse: Fern steadies the oversized strawberry sundae glass on the dessert-shop table with both hands after a bite, cheeks slightly puffed and eyes contentedly narrowed. The silver spoon rests on its saucer. Cardigan, blouse and long pleated skirt retain her town outfit beneath half-up purple hair. In the close view, pendant light warms berries and cream while afternoon window light shines through the glass; the table extends behind the dish.
